branches.consolidation: All native, documentation, and provisioning lineages merge into main through one reviewed merge-commit pull request; historical phase branches are deleted after receipt tags are pushed.
branches.mergePolicy: No force-push. No squash of the consolidation merge: committed receipts pin exact commits that must stay reachable from main.
